generation_meta_data.message: @bob @diana Are you both seeing issues that started around the same time? My report failures started Tuesday morning, same as your performance issues @bob.
@alice Yeah, the performance drop was sudden - sometime Monday night or early Tuesday. @diana when did your dashboard issues start?
@alice @bob Same timeline for me - first noticed the data gaps Tuesday morning. That's quite a coincidence that we all have issues starting at the same time...
@alice @bob @diana Wait - you all started having issues Tuesday morning? I deployed the security library updates Monday afternoon. Let me check if there's any connection...
Found something interesting. The utils-common update I did (v2.1.3 → v2.2.0) pulled in a new version of fast-json-parse as a transitive dependency. Let me investigate this deeper.
🔍 Deep dive results: fast-json-parse updated from v2.8.1 to v3.0.0. Major version change. Looking at their changelog... OH. They changed null handling behavior in v3.0.

💡 ROOT CAUSE FOUND: fast-json-parse v3.0 changed null-handling from returning `null` to returning `undefined`. This breaks: @alice's JSON serialization in reports, @bob's API null-field processing, @diana's metric parsing!
@charlie That makes perfect sense! Our report templates expect `null` for empty fields, but now getting `undefined` which breaks JSON.stringify. You found it!
@charlie Exactly! Our API response processing checks `=== null` but now gets `undefined`, so it's taking the slow path for data validation. Mystery solved.
@charlie And our metric parsing logic filters out `undefined` values as invalid, so they show as gaps. One dependency change, three different failure modes. Brilliant detective work!

generation_meta_data.description: Root cause analysis complete. utils-common v2.2.0 pulled in fast-json-parse v3.0 which changed null-handling from returning `null` to `undefined`. This broke: report JSON serialization, API null-field processing, and monitoring metric parsing across multiple teams.

✅ @charlie API response times back to 150ms! Performance is completely restored. Thanks for the quick detective work and fix.
✅ @charlie Dashboard metrics are flowing normally again, no more data gaps. All monitoring back to baseline. Great work tracking this down!
